copy.title: Query letter comps
copy.body: THE LANTERN ARCHIVE [word count] is a standalone-leaning work of magical-realist fantasy for readers of Gallant and Sea of Tranquility. Both are 2022 Breakout titles, with fit of 0.97 and 0.95 against the touchstones Piranesi, The Starless Sea, The Ten Thousand Doors of January and The Book of Lost Things (The Book of Lost Things, #1). When Women Were Dragons (fit 0.96) shows the appetite for adult fiction where the uncanny is part of ordinary grief, and The Book Eaters shows the gothic, book-centered horror lane holds at Top 1%. These comps are all recent, which is the evidence that this readership is buying now.

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The audience reads fantasy, magical realism and literary fiction, with horror and young adult crossover. Its age skew is positive only at 30–34 (+0.15) and negative in every other band. It skews male (+0.14). The same people like Welcome to Night Vale, The Magnus Archives and Within the Wires, so archive and mystery-in-the-stacks audio fiction is a natural channel, along with Strand Bookstore, Barnes & Noble and Goodreads. Qloo flags Spokane as a hidden gem, and Seattle, Providence, Buffalo, Burlington and Hartford as emerging. This is aggregate taste, not a forecast.
